name: Expand 1-node to 2-node switchless
summary: Adds a second node to an existing single-node Azure Local cluster to make it 2-node switchless: host inventory, a spec file, a checklist runbook for the physical steps, and a script for the add-node and AKS Arc nodepool steps.

tools.label: Host inventory
tools.description: Read-only iDRAC Redfish inventory of a host range (power, model, RAM, CPU, GPU, serial, health). Credentials from IDRAC_USER and IDRAC_PASS.

tools.label: Match hosts to clusters
tools.description: Read-only: which host serial belongs to which cluster, so you never add a node into itself.

tools.label: Add the node
tools.description: Runs the add-node and extends the AKS Arc nodepool from SPEC=<your spec>; --dry-run prints the plan. Changes a live cluster.

prerequisites: An existing single-node Azure Local cluster and a second matching Dell server (same model; matching GPU if the first has one) with no data to keep
Storage NICs cross-cabled to the existing node; the new node imaged with the same OS build and Arc-registered
A witness (cloud storage account or file share): mandatory at two nodes
bash, curl, the Azure CLI (logged in) and Python 3 with PyYAML
A maintenance window: the existing node may be serving workloads
claudePrompt: Read README.md and RUNBOOK.md first. Help me inventory the hosts, confirm which host belongs to which cluster, write my spec from specs/example.yaml, and work through the runbook checklist; run build/upgrade-to-2node.sh with --dry-run first and explain the plan. Stop and ask before any step that re-images, wipes, reboots, deletes or changes a server or Azure resource.
